applies_to: billing consent connected to MRL assets
exclusive_rights.non_transfer_rule: Branch operation, implementation, hosting, billing, rendering, contribution or AI assistance does not transfer Mr.liou's exercise or adjudication rights.
exclusive_rights.internal_governance_notice: This file is the canonical internal MRL governance declaration. External legal claims must be supported by applicable law, contracts and preserved evidence.

branch_delegation.principle: Branches may be independently managed within a recorded delegated scope.

mobius_closure_law.name: MRL Möbius Closure and Reversal Law
mobius_closure_law.purpose: Prevent an outward branch, platform or projection from losing the return path to the origin or reversing the source-authority relationship.
reverse_path: approved merge, release, correction or rejection
invariants: Every outward path must contain a verified return path.
No branch, mirror, platform, provider, model or generated artifact may become a new root by display, execution, billing or hosting.
The forward transformation and reverse reconstruction must preserve canonical_authority and origin_signature.
A branch may govern its local work but cannot make a final canonical ruling.
Any missing return path is a closure failure and must block canonical publication.

role_separation.provider: external execution or service provider only
role_separation.platform: hosting, billing, rendering, projection or tooling only
role_separation.branch_steward: delegated local manager without final adjudication right

equality_law: Every participant, tool, model and platform is recorded by its actual role; no lower execution layer may replace the upper canonical authority.
A platform that renders, hosts, bills or generates an artifact does not become the origin, owner or canonical authority of that artifact.
Every derivative must preserve canonical_authority, origin_signature, artifact_owner, source_repo, derived_from and provider_role.
GitHub repository owner, branch author, commit author, AI agent name and deployment vendor are operational identities, not proof of conceptual origin.
Historical errors are append-only evidence: corrections must not erase the original event, timeline or impact record.
Billing, domain binding, hosting and attribution changes require traceable consent, timestamps and rollback evidence.
No incident may be closed until correction, prevention and Mr.liou final acceptance are recorded.
